author: Logos V
title: Logos V: Baseline 2 - Classic Correction (PCA->ComBat->kNN)
abstract: This experiment establishes a second, more advanced baseline using a classic batch correction method. The pipeline is: normalization, HVG selection, PCA, followed by applying ComBat to the principal components. A kNN graph is then constructed on the ComBat-corrected PCA space. This will quantify the performance of a standard, widely-used method on this task.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from scipy.sparse import issparse

# Helper functions are kept consistent with previous experiments for comparability.
def _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, target_sum=1e4):
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=target_sum, inplace=True)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)

def _pca_array(X, n_comps=50, random_state=0):
    Xd = X.A if issparse(X) else X
    ad_tmp = ad.AnnData(Xd)
    sc.pp.pca(ad_tmp, n_comps=n_comps, svd_solver='arpack', random_state=random_state)
    return ad_tmp.obsm['X_pca']

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata):
    # Parameters from Praxis II SOTA (ID 609) for consistency
    params = {'n_pcs_graph': 50, 'k_total': 48, 'metric': 'cosine'}

    # Standard preprocessing
    _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, 1e4)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor='seurat_v3', batch_key='batch', n_top_genes=2000, inplace=True)
    hv = adata.var['highly_variable'].to_numpy()

    Xh = adata.X[:, hv]
    Xd = (Xh.A if issparse(Xh) else Xh).astype(np.float32, copy=False)

    # --- Graph Path (HYPOTHESIS TEST) ---
    # 1. Generate PCA representation of the data.
    Zg = _pca_array(Xd, n_comps=params['n_pcs_graph'], random_state=0)
    
    # 2. Apply ComBat to the PCA representation for batch correction.
    ad_combat = ad.AnnData(Zg, obs=adata.obs[['batch']].copy())
    sc.pp.combat(ad_combat, key='batch')
    Z_corrected = ad_combat.X

    # 3. Build a standard kNN graph on the ComBat-corrected PCA.
    adata.obsm['X_combat_pca'] = Z_corrected
    sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep='X_combat_pca', n_neighbors=params['k_total'], metric=params['metric'])
    
    # No separate embedding is generated as it is not the focus of this baseline.
    return adata
